description: Default capability for the Beebeeb desktop windows. Targets the compact settings/app window, the first-launch onboarding window, the Windows main app window (`main-app`), and all on-demand conflict-resolution windows (label `conflict-<file_id>`, opened by the `open_conflict_window` IPC). Also covers the Windows onboarding webview (`windows-onboarding`) and the tray popup (`tray`) so that event listeners and IPC commands work in all webviews. The macOS Beebeeb window (`main`) has its own macOS-only capability, `macos-main.json`; the retired macOS Settings window (`macos-settings`) is granted nowhere (task 1683 slice 1).
